name: Isle of Wight
description: Isle of Wight is an island ceremonial county off England's south coast, separated from Hampshire by the Solent. It is known for its coastal scenery, beaches, sailing heritage and Victorian resorts, with Newport serving as the island's main administrative centre.

places.name: Isle of Wight
places.description: An island county off England's south coast, a popular sailing and holiday destination known for the Needles chalk stacks and Queen Victoria's former residence, Osborne House.
